International Calls, Pay as you go
Yes. We don't believe in "unlocking" features. You get unlimited calls, AI summaries, CRM integrations, and call recording included. No hidden setup fees, no "Enterprise" tax.
I work on both mobile and desktop. Is that a problem?

Not at all. That's exactly how we built it. Whether you use the native mobile app or the desktop app (Mac/PC), you get the exact same power and features. Switch devices mid-day without missing a beat.
Can I keep my current business numbers?
Absolutely. We handle the porting process for you to move your existing numbers to Allo. If you need new numbers, you can generate them instantly in 80+ countries.
Do I need to talk to sales to get started?
No. You can download the app and be running in 5 minutes. However, if you have a team of 10+ and need help with a complex migration, our onboarding team is here to help.
Will this actually sync with my CRM?
Yes, and automatically. We integrate deeply with HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, and others. We log the call, the recording, and the AI summary so your team focuses on selling, not data entry.
Am I locked into a long-term contract?
Never. Allo is a monthly subscription you can cancel anytime. We prefer to earn your business every month rather than locking you in with paperwork.
